states.title: Completed work, revenue, payments and open-order balances are tracked separately.
states.body: A visit can be completed before it counts toward revenue. A prepaid package is recorded as revenue when it is sold; redeeming it settles a visit without a new payment or revenue, while an open order may still have an outstanding amount. Perelai keeps these states separate so each figure has a clear meaning.

problem.title: You already know this day
problem.pain1Body: Clients message at 11 pm. You screenshot the request, promise to check your calendar tomorrow, and forget by morning.
problem.pain2Body: What colour formula did she use last time? It is in a note, or a text, or the back of a receipt — somewhere.
problem.pain3Body: "What did I actually earn this week?" You piece it together from Venmo, cash, and a client who said she would pay next time.

devices.body: Perelai runs in a web browser. Sign in at perelai.app from wherever you are working and you are in the same workspace. On iPhone you can add it to your Home Screen, where it opens from its own icon in its own window. Installing it is optional, and there is no App Store or Google Play listing.

faq.title: Questions

q_category.question: Is this accounting software?
q_category.answer: No. Perelai is operational finance software. It tracks revenue, costs, calculated profit, recorded payments and what is still owed on open orders, with category and client breakdowns. It does not file taxes, reconcile bank accounts, produce statutory reports or give financial advice.

q_bank.question: Will the number match my bank?
q_bank.answer: Not always. PAID means a visit is settled, not that cash was received. A package sale is recorded once; redeeming its credit adds no new payment or revenue. Recorded payments and payment-account balances show money movement separately.

faq.a1: Share your booking link. Clients choose a service and time on your booking page.
faq.q2: Is there a trial, and do I need a card?
faq.a2: Try STUDIO for 21 days without a card. Your trial starts after business setup. The app shows your end date.
faq.q3: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a3: Subscribe to keep working. Without a subscription or another valid source of access, work is restricted. Trial expiry itself does not delete your data.
faq.q4: Can I work with a team?
faq.a4: Yes. STUDIO supports up to 5 active service professionals and team access. An administrator who does not provide services does not count toward that limit.
faq.q5: Is a prepaid package a subscription?
faq.a5: No. A client prepays for services to use on eligible visits. It is not a recurring charge or a Perelai subscription.
faq.q6: Is this accounting software or a payment processor?
faq.a6: No. Perelai helps manage appointments, clients and payment records. It does not provide accounting or tax reporting, or process your clients' card payments.
faq.q7: Does Perelai have an iPhone or Android app?
faq.a7: Perelai is a web app. All you need is a browser and an internet connection. There is no App Store or Google Play listing. Some browsers offer an 'Add to Home Screen' or standalone window option that gives an experience close to a native app.
faq.q8: Can I use Perelai on my laptop or iPad?
faq.a8: Open perelai.app in any supported browser on your laptop or iPad and log in with the same account. One login, one workspace. An internet connection is required.
